label: For any being g: if Jesus holds a mandate from g…, from For any being g: if Jesus holds a mandate…
meaning: The universal scope premise entails its instance at the Catholic Church: if every visible authoritative society Jesus founded was founded in the exercise of any mandate he holds and commissioned to teach, then, should Jesus have founded the Catholic Church as such a society, he founded it in that mandate and commissioned it to teach. Composes FoundingScope.scope_implies_catholic_church_scope; registers the strength order between the two scope premises (#357, #1017).
